data.name: Submit a video generation request
data.description:
Submit a video generation request
Submits a video generation request and returns a polling URL to check status
Response Codes

202 Video generation request accepted
400 Bad Request - Invalid request parameters or malformed input
401 Unauthorized - Authentication required or invalid credentials
402 Payment Required - Insufficient credits or quota to complete request
403 Forbidden - Authentication successful but insufficient permissions
404 Not Found - Resource does not exist
413 Payload Too Large - Request payload exceeds size limits
429 Too Many Requests - Rate limit exceeded
500 Internal Server Error - Unexpected server error

Response fields
Derived from the spec's response schema.
202 Video generation request accepted (object)
| Field | Type | Required | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| error | string | No |  |  |
| expires_at | integer | No |  | Unix timestamp in seconds when OpenRouter's stored copy of the outputs stops being available. Present only when that co… |
| generation_id | string | No |  | The generation ID associated with this video generation job. Available once the job has been processed. |
| id | string | Yes |  | The video job ID, in the gen-vid-<timestamp>-<20 alphanumerics> generation ID format. Pass it as previous_job_id to… |
| polling_url | string | Yes |  |  |
| status | string | Yes | pending, in_progress, completed, failed, cancelled, expired |  |
| unsigned_urls[] | array of string | No |  |  |
| usage | object | No |  | Usage and cost information for the video generation. Available once the job has completed. |
| usage.cost | number (double) or null | No |  | The cost of the video generation in USD. |
| usage.is_byok | boolean | No |  | Whether the request was made using a Bring Your Own Key configuration. |
data.evaluateGuide:
Starts a video generation job through OpenRouter and returns a polling URL for tracking it.
Use for: submit video generation, start a video job, obtain polling URL
Not supported: checking job status, downloading video content, listing models
